contexts.text: The good are continually elevated towards Heaven by the Lord, and evil is successively wiped away.
A married partner can be loved only by the good.
Hence it is that the evil cannot stay in the Societies of the good, nor the good in the Societies of the evil.
The evil think, will, and act from Hell; and the good from Heaven, that is, through Heaven from the Lord.
All the evil which the evil intend and do to the good, the Lord turns into good.
Had cared nothing whether they were good or evil. AC 5028:2. AC 5028:3.
Every Spirit and Angel sees the good on the Tight and the evil on the left. Explained.
From Divine truth and according to it, the good are judged in one way, and the evil in another. Explained. AC 7273:2. AE 502:2.
The vital fire with the evil and with the good. Explained.
In the world the good are consociated with the evil...
The avidity of snatching away and delivering the good. Signified. AC 6442.
Eminence and opulence are given to the evil; and also to the good, if they do not disagree with them and draw them away from Heaven. AC 8717:end, Explained. DP 216. DP 217.
Infernal Spirits, who are permitted thus to harass the good... AC 6681. AC 8209.
That the scientifics of good and truth taken away from the evil... shall be awarded to the good. Signified, Explained.
The retaliation... never comes from the good. Explained.
The presence of the Divine has for its sole end the protection and salvation of the good... against the evil. Treated of, Explained. AC 8700:4.
Truth Divine... perfects the good, and destroys the evil. Explained.
When the Lord protects His own... they who are in evil are indignant and angry against the good...
When the Lord protects the good against the evil, it appears like hostility...
Such (is the position) of evils and falsities with the good...
The love of good... makes the fire of life with a good man and an Angel; and the love of truth and the faith of truth make the light of life with them.
The good were separated from the evil; the good to the right, and the evil to the left...
That the evil might be ruled through the good by the Lord...
If he is good, he appears (to the Angels) as beautiful man... If evil, as a monster...
After death... the good are at once bound to the heavenly Society in which they had been in the world as to love, charity, and faith.
(The good and the evil live externally alike.) Representation.
(The infernals) cannot do any evil to the good; and if they do evil to the good, as sometimes happens, it is through conjunction with their evil...

With those who are interiorly evil and exteriorly good, good is taken away; and the converse with those who are interiorly good, and exteriorly, like other men, have hunted for riches, canvassed for dignities, been delighted with various worldly things, and favoured some concupiscences. With these, however, good and evil have not been commingled, but have been separated as internal and external. Thus in the external form they have been in many things like the evil, but not in the internal form...
A good man is a Heaven in the least form.
When the good are let from the external state into the internal one, they become still wiser and more moral.
With the good, the spirals turn forwards... thus to the Lord, and receive influx from Him.
The nearer and stronger influx into the lower parts, where the good were conjoined with the evil, held back by the Lord. Signified, Explained. AR 347.
A man cannot be reformed and regenerated, and thus become good, except through truths, and a life according to them.

For the interiorly evil may be exteriorly good... and sometimes the interiorly good may be exteriorly evil; for they may exteriorly act evils, and speak falsities, but still perform repentance, and want to be informed in truths. Signified.
Evils can be inspired into the good; but not goods into the evil.
With the good, the internal man is conjoined with Angels in Heaven.
With the good, that is, the regenerate, the Lord is universally and singularly present...
How grievous is the life even of those who are good (but not in faith) to live the life of faith. Explained. See AC 6471.
When any Spirit who is not good comes to such, they say to him that he is too good to do anything amiss; and then he either behaves as one who is good, or departs. SE 4108.
Still, it is provided by the Lord that they inflict no evil on the good; and what they endeavour to inflict is turned by the Lord into good.
How evils and falsities are removed from the good there. Explained.
A characteristic mark of the evil and the good. Explained.
They who appear (merely) as to the face good and sweet...
Unless the good were first separated from the evil...
When the good are being separated from the evil...

It is otherwise with the good... When these think from the interior memory, they think from the truths which are from good; and in like manner when they think from the exterior memory; with these the two thoughts make one; and as they are in truths from good, the internal spiritual man is opened with them...
Char 123. (How it is that good men are often loved by evil ones.)
A pious and good man receives (spiritual and natural things) in their own order in which they inflow...
